Pressure, shape and support.

Lower the same illustrative tyre onto a plane. Explore the force needed to hold each position and the pressure of its sealed air.

Legacy foundation footprint · Moving wheel

Static experiment

Lowering: 0 → 1 → 2 → 4 → 2 → 1 → 0 mm. Each point is solved in a worker, including its local stability check.

Seven static equilibria; calculation may take several seconds.

Loading reruns the input. Saved measurements are never accepted as a fresh solution.

Fixed geometry and limits

622 mm bead diameter; circular 50 mm-high illustrative section, 30 mm bead spacing; 256 circumferential stations. Fixed illustrative orthotropic material and polytropic sealed gas. No measured calibration.

Only these pressures and lowering points are received. No terrain, near-rim, insert, damage, target-load inversion or dynamic prediction. The footprint is the span of active vertices; it is not a measured contact area.
